description: Satellitenpositionierungsdienst is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB). For many applications, the accuracy of 1 m to 5 m is not sufficient, which is achieved when positioning with the available satellite systems such as GPS or GLONASS. Coverage: Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB). The portal shows the English title as "Satellite positioning service" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesvermessung und Geobasisinformation Brandenburg (LGB). Its keywords include GPS, Service, opendata, bodenbedeckung, AdVMIS, Verkehr. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
